rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone showing rebellion or refusing to conform.

example.english: My son is rebellious and always goes against his family.
example.traditional: 我個仔好反叛，成日同屋企人對住幹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 hou2 faan2 bun6 sing4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 deoi3 zyu6 gon3

rows.note: Use this especially for a child or subordinate who is rebellious in the sense of disobeying.

example.english: The child is rebellious and refuses to go to bed when told.
example.traditional: 個細路仔真係唔聽話，叫佢瞓覺都唔肯。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 zan1 hai6 m4 teng1 waa6 giu3 keoi5 fan3 gaau3 dou1 m4 hang2

rows.note: Use this for a more serious or deliberate rebellious attitude, especially when discussing teenagers or social norms.

example.english: Those teenagers are rebellious and deliberately challenge social norms.
example.traditional: 嗰班青少年好叛逆，專登挑戰社會規範。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 cing1 siu3 nin4 hou2 bun6 jik6 zyun1 dang1 tiu1 zin3 se5 wui2 kwai1 faan6
